from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
name='gpu_pack_training_single_04_mixed_accounting'
root=Path('logs/review/diag_gpu_pack_training_single_04_mixed_archive_01')
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
meta=Path('logs/runs')/(name+'.meta.json')
d=json.loads(meta.read_text())
assert d['exit_code']==1 and d['results_missing'] is True and d.get('end')
assert not (Path('results')/(name+'.json')).exists()
manifest={'scope':'Exact original failed mixed-accounting bytes preserved before the required unique-name rerun; no scientific or fee records changed.','artifacts':[]}
for suffix in ['.log','.meta.json','.diff']:
 p=Path('logs/runs')/(name+suffix)
 if not p.exists():continue
 b=p.read_bytes();q=root/p.name
 with q.open('xb') as f:f.write(b)
 assert q.read_bytes()==b
 manifest['artifacts'].append({'original_file':str(p),'archive_file':str(q),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b)})
with (root/'manifest.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(manifest,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print('PRESERVED_FAILED_MIXED_BYTES: '+json.dumps(manifest),flush=True)
